caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate object centered on a plain, light beige background. The object appears to be a decorative metal piece with intricate detailing. On the left side, there is a circular, flower-like element with black and cream-colored alternating pointed petals radiating outward. The main body of the object is brown with floral and leaf patterns in a lighter, beige color. There are two crescent shapes and other curved elements with similar beige floral designs along the body. On the upper right, there is a small, symmetrical element resembling a keyhole or stylized handle, also decorated with a floral motif. The entire object is rendered with shading and color variation, predominantly using browns, creams, and black. The background is unmarked, focusing attention on the central item.
title: Spur
